versions.changelog:
Initial release of the nerve-kanban skill.

- Provides REST API access to Nerve Kanban board for full task and workflow management.
- Supports creating, updating, deleting, reordering, and executing tasks through standard endpoints.
- Integrates proposals for agent-suggested task changes, with operator approval workflows.
- Enforces CAS versioning for concurrency control on updates and moves.
- Includes configuration endpoints and clear status transition rules for tasks.
